heading.en: Mortality is a probationary time to enable man to repent and serve God—The Fall brought temporal and spiritual death upon all mankind—Redemption comes through repentance—God Himself atones for the sins of the world—Mercy is for those who repent—All others are subject to God's justice—Mercy comes because of the Atonement—Only the truly penitent are saved. About 74 B.C.
heading.sm: O le olaga faaletino o se taimi e nofo vaavaaia ai e mafai ai e le tagata ona salamo ma auauna atu ai i le Atua—O le Pa'ū na oo mai ai le oti faaletino ma le oti faaleagaga i tagata uma—E oo mai le togiola e ala i le salamo—O le Atua lava Ia e togiola mo agasala a le lalolagi—O le alofa mutimutivale e mo i latou o e e salamo—O isi tagata uma o le a i lalo o le faamasinotonu o le Atua—E oo mai le alofa mutimutivale ona o le Togiola—Ua na'o e ua salamo faamaoni e faaolaina. E tusa o le 74 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now, my son, I perceive there is somewhat more which doth worry your mind, which ye cannot understand—which is concerning the justice of God in the punishment of the sinner; for ye do try to suppose that it is injustice that the sinner should be consigned to a state of misery.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, ua ou vaai ua i ai isi lava mea e tele ua popole i ai lou mafaufau, ia ua le mafai ona e malamalama i ai— ia ua faatatau i le faamasinotonu o le Atua i le faasalaina o le tagata agasala; ona ua e taumafai e mafaufau e faapea ua le o se faamasinotonu le tofia o le tagata agasala i se tulaga o le pagatia.

verses.en: Now behold, my son, I will explain this thing unto thee. For behold, after the Lord God sent our first parents forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground, from whence they were taken—yea, he drew out the man, and he placed at the east end of the garden of Eden, cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the tree of life—
verses.sm: O lenei faauta, lo’u atalii e, o le a ou faamalamalama atu ia te oe lenei mea. Auā faauta, ina ua uma ona auina ese atu e le Alii le Atua o tatou uluai matua mai le faatoaga o Etena, e galueaiina le eleele, lea na aumai ai i la’ua— ioe, sa ia aveesea mai le tagata, ma sa ia tuu i le pito i sasae o le faatoaga o Etena, kerupi, ma se pelu afi mumu e feliuliuai i itu uma, e leoleo le laau o le ola.

verses.en: Now, we see that the man had become as God, knowing good and evil; and lest he should put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life,  and eat and live forever, the Lord God placed cherubim and the flaming sword, that he should not partake of the fruit—
verses.sm: O lenei, ua tatou vaai ua avea le tagata e pei o le Atua, i le iloa o le lelei ma le leaga; ma ina ne’i tuu atu lona lima, ma tau foi mai le laau o le ola, ma ’ai ma ola ai e faavavau, o lea na tuu ai e le Alii le Atua ia kerupi ma le pelu afi mumu, ina ia le mafai ona ’ai o ia i le fua—

verses.en: And thus we see, that there was a time granted unto man to repent, yea, a probationary time, a time to repent and serve God.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona tatou vaai ai, e i ai se taimi ua tuu mai i le tagata e salamo ai, ioe, o se taimi e nofo vaavaaia ai, o se taimi e salamo ma auauna ai i le Atua.

verses.en: For behold, if Adam had put forth his hand immediately, and partaken of the tree of life, he would have lived forever, according to the word of God, having no space for repentance; yea, and also the word of God would have been void, and the great plan of salvation would have been frustrated.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, a na vave ona aapa atu o le lima o Atamu, ma ’ai i le laau o le ola, po ua ola o ia e faavavau, e tusa ma le afioga a le Atua, ua leai se taimi e salamo ai; ioe, ma po ua leai foi se aoga o le afioga a le Atua, ma po ua le taulau le fuafuaga tele o le faaolataga.

w.en: and also there would be no

verses.en: But behold, it was appointed unto man to die—therefore, as they were cut off from the tree of life they should be cut off from the face of the earth—and man became lost forever, yea, they became fallen man.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa tofia i le tagata ia oti— o lea, e pei ona vavae ese i la’ua mai le laau o le ola sa tatau foi ona vavae ese i la’ua mai luga o le fogaeleele— ma sa oo ina leiloa le tagata e faavavau, ioe, ua avea i la’ua ma tagata pa’ū.

w.en: so they should also be cut
from the face of the earth—

verses.en: And now, ye see by this that our first parents were cut off both temporally and spiritually from the presence of the Lord; and thus we see they became subjects to follow after their own will.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ua e vaai o lenei mea na vavae ese ai faaletino ma faaleagaga o tatou uluai matua mai luma o le Alii; ma ua faapea ona tatou vaai ai sa avea i la’ua ma ni tagata e mulimuli i o la’ua lava loto.

w.en: from the presence of the Lord;

verses.en: Now behold, it was not expedient that man should be reclaimed from this temporal death, for that would destroy the great plan of happiness.
verses.sm: O lenei faauta, sa le tatau ona toe laveai o le tagata mai lenei oti faaletino, ona e faaumatia i lena mea le fuafuaga tele o le fiafia.

verses.en: Therefore, as the soul could never die, and the fall had brought upon all mankind a spiritual death as well as a temporal, that is, they were cut off from the presence of the Lord, it was expedient that mankind should be reclaimed from this spiritual death.
verses.sm: O lea, ona e le mafai lava ona oti o le agaga, ma ua aumai e le pa’ū i luga o tagata uma se oti faaleagaga faapea foi ma se oti faaletino, o lona uiga, ua vavae ese i latou mai luma o le Alii, o lea sa tatau ai ona toe laveai o tagata mai lenei oti faaleagaga.

w.en: from the presence of the Lord,

verses.en: Therefore, as they had become carnal, sensual, and devilish, by nature, this probationary state became a state for them to prepare; it became a preparatory state.
verses.sm: O lea, talu ai ona ua avea i latou ma ni tagata faaletino, tuinanau, ma faatiapolo, i o latou natura, o lea ua avea ai lenei tulaga e nofo vaavaaia ai o se olaga mo i latou e saunia ai; ua avea o se olaga sauniuni.

verses.en: And now remember, my son, if it were not for the plan of redemption, (laying it aside) as soon as they were dead their souls were miserable, being cut off from the presence of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ia e manatua, lo’u atalii e, a na leai le fuafuaga o le togiolaina, (pe a tuu ese), o le taimi lava latou te feoti ai e pagatia ai o latou agaga, ona ua vavae ese mai luma o le Alii.

w.en: from the presence of the Lord.

verses.en: And now, there was no means to reclaim men from this fallen state, which man had brought upon himself because of his own disobedience;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, sa leai se auala e laveai ai tagata mai lenei tulaga pa’ū, lea na aumai e le tagata i ona lava luga ona o lona lava le usiusitai;

verses.en: Therefore, according to justice, the plan of redemption could not be brought about, only on conditions of repentance of men in this probationary state, yea, this preparatory state; for except it were for these conditions, mercy could not take effect except it should destroy the work of justice. Now the work of justice could not be destroyed; if so, God would cease to be God.
verses.sm: O lea, e tusa ma le faamasinotonu, e le mafai ona faataunuuina o le fuafuaga o le togiola, ua na o tulaga lava o le salamo o tagata i lenei olaga e nofo vaavaaia ai, ioe, lenei olaga sauniuni; ona vagana ai nei tulaga, e le mafai ona aoga le alofa mutimutivale vagana ai ua ia faaumatiaina le galuega a le faamasinotonu. O lenei e le mafai ona faaumatiaina le galuega a le faamasinotonu; a faapea, po ua le toe avea le Atua ma Atua.

verses.en: And thus we see that all mankind were fallen, and they were in the grasp of justice; yea, the justice of God, which consigned them forever to be cut off from his presence.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona tatou vaai ai ua pa’u’ū tagata uma, ma ua ia i latou le iloa o le faamasinotonu; ioe, le faamasinotonu o le Atua, lea e tofiaina i latou ia vavae ese mai ona luma e faavavau.

w.en: to be cut off from his presence

verses.en: And now, the plan of mercy could not be brought about except an atonement should be  made; therefore God himself atoneth for the sins of the world, to bring about the plan of mercy, to appease the demands of justice, that God might be a perfect, just God, and a merciful God also.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e le mafai ona faataunuuina le fuafuaga o le alofa mutimutivale vagana ai ua faia se togiola; o lea ua togiola ai e le Atua lava ia mo agasala a le lalolagi, e faataunuu ai le fuafuaga o le alofa mutimutivale, e faamalie ai manaoga o le faamasinotonu, ina ia mafai ona avea le Atua ma Atua ua atoatoa, faamasinotonu, ma se Atua alofa mutimutivale foi.

w.en: for the sins of the world,

verses.en: Now, repentance could not come unto men except there were a punishment, which also was eternal as the life of the soul should be, affixed opposite to the plan of happiness, which was as eternal also as the life of the soul.
verses.sm: O lenei, e le mafai ona o’o mai le salamo i tagata vagana ua i ai se faasalaga, o lea ua faavavau foi e pei ona tatau ai i le ola o le agaga, ua faaopoopo e faafeagai ma le fuafuaga o le fiafia, lea ua faavavau foi e pei o le ola o le agaga.

verses.en: Now, how could a man repent except he should sin? How could he sin if there was no law? How could there be a law save there was a punishment?
verses.sm: O lenei, e mafai faapefea ona salamo o se tagata vagana ai ua agasala o ia? E mafai faapefea ona agasala o ia pe afai ua leai se tulafono? E faapefea ona i ai o se tulafono vagana ai ua i ai se faasalaga?

verses.en: Now, there was a punishment affixed, and a just law given, which brought remorse of conscience unto man.
verses.sm: O lenei, sa i ai se faasalaga faaopoopo, ma se tulafono faamasinotonu na tuuina mai, lea ua aumai ai le faanoanoa o le mafaufau i le tagata.

verses.en: Now, if there was no law given—if a man murdered he should die—would he be afraid he would die if he should murder?
verses.sm: O lenei, afai e leai se tulafono na tuuina mai— afai e fasioti tagata se tagata e tatau ona oti o ia— pe fefe ea o le a oti o ia pe afai e fasioti tagata?

verses.en: And also, if there was no law given against sin men would not be afraid to sin.
verses.sm: Ma lenei foi, afai e leai se tulafono e tuuina mai e faasaga i le agasala o le a le fefefe tagata e agasala.

verses.en: And if there was no law given, if men sinned what could justice do, or mercy either, for they would have no claim upon the creature?
verses.sm: Ma afai e leai se tulafono e tuuina mai, afai e agasala tagata, o le a se mea e mafai ona fai e le faamasinotonu, po o le alofa mutimutivale foi, ona o le a leai so la’ua aafiaga i luga o le tagata?

verses.en: But there is a law given, and a punishment affixed, and a repentance granted; which repentance mercy claimeth; otherwise, justice claimeth the creature and executeth the law, and the law inflicteth the punishment; if not so, the works of justice would be destroyed, and God would cease to be God.
verses.sm: Peitai e i ai se tulafono ua tuuina mai, ma se faasalaga ua faaopoopo, ma se salamo ua tuuina mai; le salamo lea, ua aia ai le alofa mutimutivale; a leai, e aafia e le faamasinotonu le tagata ma faataunuu le tulafono, ma o le tulafono na te faaooina le faasalaga; afai e le faapea, o le a faaumatia galuega a le faamasinotonu, ma o le a faamuta ona avea o le Atua ma Atua.

verses.en: But God ceaseth not to be God, and mercy claimeth the penitent, and mercy cometh because of the atonement; and the atonement bringeth to pass the resurrection of the dead; and the resurrection of the dead bringeth back men into the presence of God; and thus they are restored into his presence, to be judged according to their works, according to the law and justice.
verses.sm: Ae e le faamutaina le avea o le Atua ma Atua, ma ua fai mo le alofa mutimutivale le tagata ua salamo, ma e oo mai le alofa mutimutivale ona o le togiola; ma ua aumai e le togiola le toetutū mai o e ua oti; ma o le toetutū mai o e ua oti ua toe aumai ai tagata i luma o le Atua; ma faapea ona toefuatai ai o i latou i ona luma, e faamasinoina e tusa ma a latou galuega, e tusa ma le tulafono ma le faamasinotonu.

verses.en: For behold, justice exerciseth all his demands, and also mercy claimeth all which is her own; and thus, none but the truly penitent are saved.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, e faatino e le faamasinotonu ona manaoga uma; ma e maua foi e le alofa mutimutivale mea uma e a ia lava; ma o lea, e leai se tasi ae ua na’o ē lava ua salamo moni e faaolaina.

verses.en: What, do ye suppose that mercy can rob justice? I say unto you, Nay; not one whit. If so, God would cease to be God.
verses.sm: E a ea, e te manatu ea e mafai e le alofa mutimutivale ona faoa le faamasinotonu? Ou te fai atu ia te oe, E leai; e leai sina iota e tasi. Afai o lea, po ua le toe avea le Atua ma Atua.

verses.en: And thus God bringeth about his great and eternal purposes, which were prepared from the foundation of the world. And thus cometh about the salvation and the redemption of men, and also their destruction and misery.
verses.sm: Ma e faapea ona faataunuu e le Atua ona faamoemoega tetele ma faavavau, ia sa saunia mai le faavaega o le lalolagi. Ma e faapea ona o’o mai o le faaolataga ma le togiolaina o tagata, ma lo latou faafanoga ma lo latou pagatia foi.

w.en: from the foundation of the world.

verses.en: Therefore, O my son, whosoever will come may come and partake of the waters of life freely; and whosoever will not come the same is not compelled to come; but in the last day it shall be restored unto him according to his deeds.
verses.sm: O lea, lo’u atalii e, soo se tasi e fia sau, e mafai ona sau ma inu saoloto i vai o le ola; ma soo se tasi e le fia sau, o ia lava lea ua le faamalosia e sau; ae i le aso gataaga, o le a toefuatai mai ia te ia e tusa ma ana galuega.

verses.en: If he has desired to do evil, and has not repented in his days, behold, evil shall be done unto him, according to the restoration of God.
verses.sm: Afai sa manao o ia e fai le leaga, ma sa le’i salamo i ona aso, faauta, o le a faia le leaga ia te ia, e tusa ma le toefuataiga a le Atua.

verses.en: And now, my son, I desire that ye should let these things trouble you no more, and only let your sins trouble you, with that trouble which shall bring you down unto repentance.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, ou te manao ia e tuu nei mea ia le toe faalavelave ia te oe, ae ia na’o au agasala ia e popole i ai, le popole lena e aumai ai oe i lalo i le salamo.

verses.en: O my son, I desire that ye should deny the justice of God no more. Do not endeavor to excuse yourself in the least point because of your sins, by denying the justice of God; but do you let the justice of God, and his mercy, and his long– suffering have full sway in your heart; and let it bring you down to the dust in humility.
verses.sm: E, lo’u atalii e, ou te manao ia e le toe faafitia le faamasinotonu a le Atua. Aua e te taumafai e tauamiotonuina oe lava i se mataupu itiiti ona o au agasala, i lou faafitia o le faamasinotonu o le Atua; ae ia aua le avea le faamasinotonu a le Atua, ma lona alofa mutimutivale, ma lona tali-tiga e tosina atoa ai lou loto; ma ia e tuu lenei mea e ave ifo ai oe i lalo i le efuefu i le lotomaualalo.

verses.en: And now, O my son, ye are called of God to preach the word unto this people. And now, my son, go thy way, declare the word with truth and soberness, that thou mayest bring souls unto repentance, that the great plan of mercy may have claim upon them. And may God grant unto you even according to my words. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, ua valaauina oe e le Atua e te tala’i atu le upu i lenei nuu. Ma o lenei, lo’u atalii e, alu ia i lou ala, ta’u atu le upu ma le faamaoni ma le mamalu, ina ia mafai ona e aumai o agaga i le salamo, ina ia mafai ona maua e le fuafuaga tele o le alofa mutimutivale le aafiaga ia i latou. Ma ia alofa le Atua ia tuuina mai ia te oe e tusa ai ma a’u upu. Amene.
